exercise.title: Name the chord you hear
exercise.why: Am9, D9 and Gmaj7 are built on a minor 7, a dominant 7 and a major 7, so naming those three by ear is naming what your hands play when you comp.

cells.text: Press Start in the game below: it plays a chord on a new root each time, and you pick Major, Minor, Dominant 7, Major 7 or Minor 7. Listen to the top of the chord first. Practice until the name comes before you work it out.
